model.calibration_note: E[spread] $7/MWh is structural model assumption. Aug 04 Tenaska actual HE10 spread was $1.09/MWh (7x lower). Conservative E[spread] = $2/MWh. Direction signal high confidence; magnitude unverified pending SB restoration.

structural_data.nl_trough_comment: 26,000-29,000 MW MODERATE range; 477 MW above SEVERE boundary (26,000 MW). Second deepest duck of heat event series after Aug 04-05 SEVERE (23,639-25,190 MW). 1,715 MW deeper than Aug 06 HE10 (28,192 MW, 2nd analog).
structural_data.nl_he11_comment: 28,130 MW — nearly identical to Aug 06 HE10 (28,192 MW), which resulted in structural INC WIN. MODERATE tier, 1,870 MW above SEVERE.
structural_data.nl_ramp_he18_he21_comment: 17,605 MW. Below DEC v5 condition 1 threshold (20,000 MW). DEC not triggered.
structural_data.solar_cliff_comment: New heat event extreme — steepest single-hour solar collapse of the series at HE19->HE20.
structural_data.gr_west_min_comment: GR_WEST HE14 trough = 5,156 MW. Recovery from Sunday's 1,942 MW catastrophic low (+3.2 GW), but still below pre-dome August baseline 6-8 GW. Single-source STWPF — no AG2 cross-validation (Day 15).
structural_data.gr_west_he21_comment: Strong wind buffer at net-load peak. +1,766 MW vs 08/09 (8,445 MW). Reduces HE21 spike risk vs prior days.
structural_data.gr_coastal_comment: New Aug event high for sea breeze. Consistent with thermal dome weakening along Gulf Coast.
structural_data.cap_out_he10_comment: 9,702 MW at duck floor — new Aug series high and highest coincident duck+cap-out reading of event. 298 MW from HOUSTON_SOUTH dual-trigger threshold. Anomalous AS demand at energy price floor. Introduces RT floor risk (AS scarcity) that partially opposes INC signal — net INC still preferred given NL depth.
structural_data.cap_out_he24_comment: -1,815 MW drop at HE24 — mass return of planned maintenance units. Constructive for 08/11 reserve margin.
structural_data.inc_block_note: Upper 32% > 20% threshold. INC block active HE01-07. NL also NEGLIGIBLE (38.6-43.6k MW) — SKIP on P independent of block.
structural_data.inc_block_evening_note: HE22-24 WEST_TO_NORTH evening resurgence (SCI 0.394-0.466). Block applies but NL NEGLIGIBLE (44.9-55.4k MW) — SKIP on P first.

positions.p_win_fundamental_note: NL 26,477 MW MODERATE_LOWER interpolated from Aug 06 HE10 (28,192 MW -> 62% fundamental) + 1,715 MW deeper = +1 ppt
positions.floor_pass_note: 0.6 x $7 = $4.20 >= $4.00. Barely passes. If E[spread] = $2 (08/04 anchor), floor = $1.20 FAILS. Direction signal drives entry, not floor.
positions.cap_out_note: Anomalously high cap-out at duck floor. Creates AS demand at HE10. Partially opposes RT suppression but INC direction still preferred.
positions.risk_note: MODERATE_LOWER tier; 08/04 Tenaska actual spread $1.09 (vs model $7) — E[P50] range $8-$91. Cap-out 9,702 MW AS tail risk. GR_WEST STWPF unvalidated (single-source Day 15). SB-DEGRADED +/-5 ppt uncertainty on P.
positions.analog_reference: Aug 06 HE10: NL 28,192 MW MODERATE, P=59%, 10 MW, structural WIN. Aug 09 HE10: NL 27,151 MW MODERATE, P=56%, 10 MW, TBD. Aug 10 HE10: 1,715 MW deeper than Aug 06 analog, P=60% (1 ppt above HIGH threshold). Sized to full 20 MW.

positions.floor_pass_note: 0.6 x $7 = $4.20 >= $4.00. Barely passes. Same calibration caveat as HE10.

skips.detail: NL 38,622-43,556 MW NEGLIGIBLE. WEST_TO_NORTH_345 HE01-07 MEDIUM 22-32% binding. Upper 32% > 20% INC block threshold -> INC BLOCK applied. P(INC) ~48-49% even without block. Skip on P + block.

HE08 NL 42,319 MW NEGLIGIBLE (P ~49%). HE09 NL 32,453 MW NEGLIGIBLE (barely > 32,000 MW threshold; P ~51%). Both below 55% minimum. HE09 is NOT MILD (32,453 > 32,000 MW MILD upper boundary) — confirmed NEGLIGIBLE. Solar still ramping at HE08-09 (3,020-17,147 MW).
NL 32,753 MW NEGLIGIBLE. P(INC) ~48%. Solar at HE12 = 32,253 MW (near plateau peak). No INC signal.
NL 37,240 MW NEGLIGIBLE. P(INC) ~47%. GR_WEST 5,165 MW < 5,500 MW (veto condition 1 MET) but Load 79,996 MW < 80,000 MW (condition 2 NOT MET by 4 MW) -> VETO NOT triggered. Skip on P regardless.

GR_WEST 5,156-5,486 MW < 5,500 MW AND Load 83,429-85,192 MW > 80,000 MW. Both conditions met for both hours. RT spike risk prohibits both INC and DEC positions. GR_WEST at heat event trough zone with Monday WDPEAK load at full peak.
NL 41,140-41,679 MW NEGLIGIBLE. P(INC) ~47-48%. GR_WEST 5,866-6,944 MW >= 5,500 MW -> veto condition 1 NOT MET. No veto needed; skip on P.

NL ramp HE18->HE21 = 17,605 MW < 20,000 MW threshold -> DEC v5 condition 1 FAIL. P(DEC win) structural = 31% (well below 55% minimum). SOUTH_HOUSTON P(binding) 13-23% central 18% -- LOW-MEDIUM, insufficient for DEC signal. Strong wind buffer (ERCOT total HE21 = 19,845 MW, +4,108 MW vs 08/09) further suppresses DEC win probability.
skips.wind_buffer_note: ERCOT wind HE21 = 19,845 MW (+4,108 MW vs 08/09 15,737 MW). GR_WEST HE21 = 10,211 MW (+1,766 MW). Reduces P(RT spike) vs prior event days.

skips.detail: NL 44,927-55,379 MW NEGLIGIBLE. P(INC) ~49-50%. WEST_TO_NORTH_345 MEDIUM 22-32% evening (SCI 0.394-0.466, strongest Aug evening). INC block: upper 32% > 20% threshold -> block triggered. Skip on P before block applies.

summary.duck_floor_comment: 477 MW above SEVERE boundary. Second deepest of heat event. Monday WDPEAK = strongest day type (no penalty beyond SB-DEGRADED -3 ppt).
summary.gr_west_veto_hours_detail: HE14-15 only (vs 5 hours HE14-18 on 08/09). GR_WEST recovers to 5,866 MW by HE16 (above 5,500 MW veto threshold) — veto window compressed by wind recovery.
summary.wdpeak_monday_note: First WDPEAK Monday of Week 3 heat event. No day-type penalty beyond SB-DEGRADED. Strongest structural day for INC duck positions. Two active positions vs Aug 09 Sunday (1 position) and Aug 06 Thursday (2 positions).

bear.note: E[P50 sym] = (2x0.60-1)x(-5)x20 + (2x0.59-1)x(-5)x10 = -$20 + -$9 = -$29 ... wait: if spread is negative for INC, INC LOSES; expected loss = 0.60 x (-5x20) + 0.40 x ... actually INC loses when spread < 0. Bear spread = -$5 means INC always loses in this scenario: -$5x20 + -$5x10 = -$150
